bbq-grillborste-ultra.title: BBQ Brush Ultra – Effective Cleaning for Your BBQ
bbq-grillborste-ultra.descriptionHtml:
Keep your BBQ in top shape with our BBQ Brush Ultra.
Fitted with hard-wearing steel bristles and a handy scraper, it makes short work of burnt-on food and grease on the grates. Perfect if you want a clean BBQ fast, with no fuss.

The ergonomic handle gives you a solid grip even when the brush is used on hot surfaces, and the compact design makes it easy to store or take along.

Features:

  • Hard-wearing stainless steel bristles

  • Built-in scraper for burnt-on residue

  • Ergonomic handle for a comfortable grip

  • Effective cleaning for both charcoal and gas BBQs

  • Light and easy to use

With the BBQ Brush Ultra you get a reliable cleaning brush that makes barbecuing easier and more enjoyable – always ready for the next BBQ night!

aa.title: Premium BBQ & Smash Burger Kit – Complete Stainless Steel Set with Accessories & Storage Bag
aa.descriptionHtml:
This is not just another BBQ tool set, it is the dream kit for anyone who loves to barbecue, cook smash burgers and show off at the flat-top griddle. With a full 25 stainless steel pieces you get everything you need to turn your BBQ or our stainless steel flat-top griddle into a full-scale outdoor pro kitchen.

We are not talking about a few basic tools here. This is a well-thought-out kit with gear that is built to last, designed to deliver the best possible results and packed in a hard-wearing bag so you can take it anywhere – to the BBQ night, the campsite or the holiday house.

Why our customers love this kit:

  • Everything you need in one pack – spatulas, scrapers, bottles, spice shakers, burger press, ring moulds, splatter guard, tongs, basting brush and much more.

  • Built for smash burgers – the heavy cast iron burger press and the rings for eggs or mini burgers make it easy to nail that perfect restaurant feel at home.

  • Pair it with our griddle – together, this set becomes the ultimate gift for any BBQ fanatic. The flat-top griddle gives you even heat distribution, and with this kit you can cook everything from smash burgers and quesadillas to veggies and fish.

  • Pro quality at home – made from stainless steel with timber and rubber details for the best feel and durability.

  • Perfect as a gift – an unforgettable present for the son, husband or mate who loves cooking outdoors. A set that oozes quality, passion and BBQ joy.

Includes, among other things:

  • 4 different spatulas for different jobs

  • Scrapers and cleaning tools for easy clean-up

  • Cast iron burger press for smash burgers with the perfect crust

  • Stainless steel melting dome for steam-melting cheese or quick cooking

  • Egg rings and burger moulds for perfect shapes

  • Spice shakers and bottles for sauces and oil

  • Hard-wearing storage bag for every piece

In short:

This set turns every BBQ night into an experience. It is the difference between just “chucking something on the barbie” and truly creating restaurant quality at home on the deck.

When you bring out this kit, you will feel the same pride a chef feels in their kitchen. It is clever, practical, robust and above all fun to use.

👉 For $209.95 AUD you are not just getting a kit of tools. You are getting a complete experience, memories for life and the best gear you can give yourself, your son or your husband who loves to barbecue and experiment in the kitchen.
